title: UN sends warning as satellite detects greenhouse gas plumes over Gorgon plant
paragraphs: Huge clouds of methane have been detected by satellite over Chevron's Gorgon LNG project in northern WA, prompting a warning from the United Nations.
Methane is thought to be responsible for about 25 per cent of global warming.
The WA government is investigating the reports "to understand what compliance or regulatory measures may be required".
